description:
REGRESSION exposed in the round range (s531d round attribution, s532): t/comp/parser.t row 45 "-F calls the F function" (`is(eval q{ sub F { 42 } -F 1 }, '-42', ...)`) passed on MAIN-READY-49 d8577478 and fails from MAIN-READY-50 c65c9dac (s527b) on, through MAIN-READY-63 b31345ca and the s531d tree.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):
  sub K { 42 } my $t = -K 1; print "$t\n";      perl: -42    PCL: dies "Undefined subroutine &main::(p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-K))) called"
  sub F { 42 } -F 1                              (as an eval string: perl -42; PCL undef + the same die)
  -K(1) is right on every PCL version (-42).

MECHANISM (read from the emission, not yet fixed): PPI lexes `-K` as ONE Word.  #3344's ExprToCL::_negated_call_form answers (p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-K))) for that Word, and at the FUNCALL-HEAD site the answer is used as the callee NAME when arguments follow without parens: the emission is `(|pl-(p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-F)))| 1)`.  perl's toke.c: `-IDENT LIST` with IDENT a declared sub is -(IDENT(LIST)).  The fix belongs at that one site: a `-NAME` head WITH arguments lowers to (p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-NAME ARGS...))) -- probe the prototype interactions (`sub K ($) {..}`; `-K 1, 2` = -(K(1,2)) for a list sub, -(K(1)), 2 for a unary one) against perl.

WHY the row passed before s527b: on d8577478 PPI lexed `-F` after the sub's closing `}` as the operator `-` + the Word `F`, so PCL emitted (p-- (pl-F 1)) = -42.  s527b's PPI fix (Â§35, a statement after a block's `}` lexes like any statement start -- the #1817 `-f 'TEST'` fix) makes `-F` ONE Word there too, which reaches the broken head arm.  The file-level spelling with a `;` between (`sub K { 42 } ... ; my $t = -K 1;`) fails on d8577478 as well: the bug is #3344's, the row is s527b's exposure.

Bisect evidence: scratch/s531d/bislog/chunk*.log + scratch/s531d/bisdiff.pl comp/parser.t (worktree agent-a5284a29dfcfe8e48); probes scratch/s531d/p/negf2.pl negf3.pl negf4.pl.  Row re-caused in baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv to this task.  Related: #476 (the declared-sub-without-prototype half), #3344 (completed; its funcall-head arm).
subject: REGRESSION (row): `-NAME LIST` -- a declared sub called with arguments and no parens -- emits a call to a sub NAMED by the negated form, `(|pl-(p-- (p-scalar-ctx (pl-K)))| 1)`; dies "Undefined subroutine"; perl -(K(1)) -- comp/parser.t "-F calls the F function" since s527b
